1.0.0.en: Added Comfort profiles to allow easier control over the thermostats

1.0.2.en: First public release: control ecobee comfort profiles (Home/Away/Sleep), thermostat mode, temperature and fan, plus ecobee room sensors.

1.0.3.en: New app and device artwork, a clearer store description, and tidied-up Flow cards.

1.0.4.en: Added Insights history logging: temperature, humidity, mode, comfort profile, hold status, and motion are now recorded over time and appear in the device history and Insights.

1.1.0.en: Added aux heat only: a new Aux heat choice in the thermostat mode picker and mode cards, plus Flow cards to switch to aux heat only, restore the previous mode afterwards, and check for aux heat only mode. Aux heat only now shows as Aux heat instead of Heat.
